what.text: This page follows refugees from Afghanistan living in Germany.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 288286 Afghan refugees in Germany, 10.8% of all Afghan refugees.
Only Pakistan and Iran host more.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan from 1997 to 2025, at war level from 1997 to 2001 and from 2005 to 2021.
The groups involved include the Taleban, the Hizb-i Islami-yi Afghanistan, the NRF and the AFF.
UCDP also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's figure for Germany rose from 52289 in 2002 to 288286 in 2025, its highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025, after big changes between 2015 and 2017.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Germany only, and UNHCR adds notes to some of them.
Gender and age are known for only part of this group.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
